infoLinks.content:
From 3am until 9pm on Sunday 21 September, route 418 and 426 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the Dulwich Hill Festival event.  

Services will divert around a section of Marrickville Road via Wardell Road, Frazer Street and New Canterbury Road. 
 
Route 426 services travelling towards Dulwich Hill will start end trips at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (Stop ID 220354). Route 426 services travelling away from Dulwich Hill will start trips at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350).  
 
Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed and alternative stops: 
  • Dulwich Hill Shops, Marrickville Rd (Stop ID 220317) – Alternative stop at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350) 
  • Marrickville Rd at Fairfowl St (Stop ID 220339) – Alternative stop at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350) 
  • Marrickville Rd before Wardell Rd (Stop ID 220340) – Alternative stop at Marrickville Rd at Woodcourt St (220478)

  • Route 807 buses will divert around a section of Railway Parade and miss stops due to road closures for the Cabramatta Moon Festival event.
  • Services will start and end their trips at a temporary bus stop on Railway Parade between McBurney Road and Hughes Street.
  • Services travelling to Cabramatta will divert via Hill Street and McBurney Road to the temporary stop on Railway Parade. Services travelling from Cabramatta will start trips from the temporary stop on Railway Parade then divert via Hughes Street and Hill Street to return to route.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight full closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Monday 29 September to Wednesday 1 October
 
Nightly from 9pm to 1am, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including:
  • Replacement bus services or regular bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford,
  • Train services, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
Replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 9pm to 1am nightly. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Surry Hills (towards Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Chalmers Street (approx. 8 minute walk),
  • Wansey Road (towards Central) - Please use the alternative stop at Royal Randwick (approx. 12 minute walk),
  • UNSW High Street (towards Central and Randwick) - Please use the alternative stop at Randwick (approx. 10 minute walk).
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
See the news story for more detailed service information.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
